transcript.answer: Otto was never built on Cloud Run. Issue #27 planned Cloud Run in europe-north1 so the service would sit in the same region as the Vertex model, which was meant to answer OLT's NIS-2 data-residency condition. Otto was deployed with Helm to the shared GKE cluster in europe-west1 instead, and ADR-003 (accepted 2026-10-19, issue #414) records that. The sources I found do not say why the team chose GKE over Cloud Run. They do say the premise for europe-north1 no longer holds. Measurements on 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-16 showed that europe-north1 serves only the Gemini 2.5 models, which retire on 2026-10-20. After that date no Gemini model on Vertex runs in europe-north1. The newer 3.x and 4 models are served only from the `eu` multi-region. Cloud Run beside the model in europe-north1 therefore no longer gave a co-located, EU-resident setup. The planned ADR-001 (docs/adr/ADR-001-hosting-platform.md) was never written, and ADR-003 supersedes it. Issues #27, #162 and #168 were closed as superseded.

judgements.reason: The answer gives the essential reason: europe-north1 served only Gemini 2.5, which retired on 2026-10-20, and newer models answer only on the eu multi-region. It also says Otto runs on the shared GKE cluster in europe-west1 and that #27, #162 and #168 were closed as superseded, so it covers the gold answer without contradicting it.
